name: emitted-size-view
goal: The embedded viewer shows the size of what a unit emits for each execution target with its frozen limit: in the component panel at any revision, in the growth view commit by commit with the review that set or changed the limit and the reason and evidence of the change, and in the comparison; a missing limit, an output that could not be built and a unit that emits nothing are said as such

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Per-target emitted limits were enforced but invisible: the component panel, the growth view and the comparison showed source, complexity and dependencies only, and the index held neither the emitted sizes per target nor the ledger. Success: the panel lists each target's bytes and limit at any revision; growth shows each target commit by commit with the limit it was verified under, the baseline or approval with before and after, the reason and the way to the evidence; the comparison has each target on both sides; a missing limit, an unbuilt output and a unit that emits nothing are said as such; all of it is read from the index. Proof: index tests through the public commands, unit tests, a browser spec at three viewports with keyboard access, new scenario states captured and looked at, the unchanged browser suite.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Index: growth points carry emitted sizes by target and notes for an unbuilt output; units carry their reviews; a revision's unit view carries the limits its ledger freezes per target (new unit function.budget-reviews; function.history-series, function.revision-registry, service.revision-detail, service.history-index, function.history-index-types). Growth now takes only a unit's own figures, not what a benchmark reported. Viewer: reports.function.harness-emitted, reports.function.harness-emitted-growth, reports.component.harness-harness-emitted-growth, reports.model.harness-budget-types, and the unit panel, growth view and comparison. Fixture: reports.script.harness-emitted-seed adds a unit built for two targets to the synthetic history through the real commands.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Red: work/logs/stage-f-emitted-view-index-RED.log (test/history-emitted.e2e.test.ts, 3 failed on the unchanged index) and work/logs/stage-f-emitted-view-browser-RED.log (tests/e2e/harness-emitted.spec.ts, 12 failed against the console built before the change: the panel held source-bytes, complexity and dependencies only). Green: test/history-emitted.e2e.test.ts 3 passed, test/utils/budget-reviews.test.ts 3 passed, packages/reports/test/utils/harness-emitted.test.ts 4 passed, tests/e2e/harness-emitted.spec.ts 12 passed at desktop, tablet and mobile with the evidence button opened by keyboard (work/logs/stage-f-emitted-view-browser-green-2.log). The console scenario gained the states emitted, emitted-gone and emitted-growth, captured at three viewports and looked at: work/stage-f/emitted-view/evidence. The real kernel unit of this repository reads process 402048 bytes and Wasm 143132 bytes with no limit recorded: work/stage-f/own-emitted/evidence and identity.json.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: bun run check exit 0 on the working tree (work/logs/stage-f-check-12.log): 461 unit tests with 25 live-API tests skipped, 186 command-line end-to-end tests in 57 files, 26 package tests with 3 scale tests skipped, the three browser-run tests one after another with 5 passed, 125 reports unit tests in 56 files, audit and registry check passed. Whole browser suite on the final build: 132 passed, 1 skipped (work/logs/stage-f-emitted-view-browser-suite-final.log). Two earlier full checks were red and are kept: check 10 failed the console's own rule that lists are keyed by position, so the new lists were keyed by position; check 11 timed out waiting for four fixture seeds at once in the package tests, so the three browser-run tests now run one after another there, with no wait changed. The complete verification was not run; it is Codex's.
